description: Make project exports relationship-complete and expose durable comparison provenance consistently in JSON, CSV, MCP sections, and audit metadata.
steps: Extend export_project_csv to emit every compound_relationship with relationship/source/review/notes/context/evidence/provenance fields and include durable comparison audit linkage in analysis_run metadata.

Keep JSON/CSV project filtering and relationship/provenance semantics equivalent, preserve formula-injection safety and bounded export behavior, and make sar_export_overview explicitly disclose its audit side effect.
Add parity, project-isolation, audit-link, and MCP descriptor/integration tests without weakening browser-only governance.
acceptance_criteria: JSON and CSV exports contain equivalent relationship IDs, project scope, explicit pair references, review/source fields, notes, context, evidence, and data_origin.
Durable comparison export records expose analysis_run_id and audit_event_id with algorithm, endpoint, relationship, summary, source measurement, and evidence-boundary provenance.
Foreign project relationship or audit rows cannot appear in an export or MCP section result, and export audit writes are accurately described.
verification: pixi run python -m pytest -q tests/test_export_api.py tests/test_mcp_unit.py tests/test_mcp_integration.py
findings: Resolves review finding 3 and implements AC-013, AC-014, and AC-022.
